title: Yolo  + Transcription Web App
description:
Project Description

Fee: 10-20 hrs @ standard rate

Full detail available in project description here, which includes propsoed steps on the final page:
[URL]

Video Processing and Transcription Web Application Description

We are developing a video processing and transcription application that simplifies the process of uploading videos, performing object detection, and generating transcriptions. The application will use Azure Blob Storage for input and output storage, while Azure Functions will automate the processing pipeline.

Users will interact with a straightforward web interface to upload their videos. The system will then employ PyTorch Lightning and the YOLO model for object detection, creating bounding boxes around objects in the video. In addition, Google GCP Transcription will be leveraged to generate transcriptions of the video's audio.

A custom table containing 10 variables will be designed and implemented to store data extracted from the video. The output file will combine the object detection results, transcription, and custom table data in a user-friendly format. The results will be stored in a separate output container in Azure Blob Storage.

A Streamlit web application will be developed to display the contents of the input and output containers, enabling users to download the output files. The application will be deployed on an Azure instance for easy access.

Our goal is to create a user-friendly, efficient, and scalable solution for video processing and transcription.

Job Description:

We need a freelancer with Full Stack experience to build a video processing and transcription application using Azure, PyTorch Lightning, YOLO, Google GCP Transcription, and Streamlit. The application will allow users to upload videos, perform object detection and transcription, and generate output files with bounding boxes and transcriptions. We need this person to possess strong skills in web development, cloud services, machine learning, and data

Initial Responsibilities:

1.	Set up and configure Azure Blob Storage for input and output containers.
2.	Develop a simple drag-and-drop web page for uploading video files.
3.	Implement video upload to Azure Blob Storage using the Azure SDK.
4.	Create Azure Functions to automatically trigger when a new file is uploaded.
5.	Integrate PyTorch Lightning and YOLO for object detection and bounding box creation.
6.	Implement Google GCP Transcription for video transcription.
7.	Design and implement a custom table with 10 variables for storing relevant data.
8.	Combine object detection, transcription, and custom table data into a single output file with the desired format.
9.	Save the output file in the output container in Azure Blob Storage.
10.	Develop a Streamlit web application to display the contents of the input and output containers, allowing users to download the output files.
11.	Deploy the Streamlit app on an Azure instance.
12.	Test the application thoroughly, fix any issues, and optimize for performance and scalability.
13.	Write clear documentation and user guides for the application.

title: Image processing expert with math background and C# to auto-extract geometrical features
description:
PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.

We are looking for an experienced image processing / computer vision engineer who has strong mathematical geometry and statistics background including C# programming. We are NOT looking for somebody with deep learning skills.

We have designed a UI (C#-based app) that loads segmented images of plants (more than 35K images (2 separate datasets of various plant species). This UI could extract traits such as projected area, convex hull area, perimeter, diameter, bounding box area, circumference, eccentricity, roundness, solidity, extent, circularity, convex hull perimeter, etc. However, some calculations are wrong due to the segmentation issues (about 15 - 20% of images contain the issue of a not well-segmented certain part of a plant). Pixel area is calibrated into the physical coordinates (millimeters), but it also need to be verified in order to confirm that geometrical calculations are correct.

Therefore, all existing geometrical calculations should be doubled checked. Numerical values of these calculations are written in excel files, and this needs verification by re-plotting in excel. We want to make sure that numerical values (pixel values calibrated into physical coordinates) are correct.

After that, time-series data normalization needs to be established (se attached document) since traditional time-series data normalisation methods cannot be applied because of the allometric scaling of growth in plants. Normalization is important to find data trends such as growth rate and similar.

Similarly, for leaf there are certain image processing tasks that need to be applied such as auto-detecting every leaf and auto-coloring (auto-labelling of leaves) and numbering the leaves in the specifically generated dataset, counting total number of leaves per day, extract leaf area (there should be correct leaf area estimation even though on a leaf is cover by other neighboring leaf), percentage of overlapping (occlusion) between leaves, leaf length (including stem), convex hull of leaf, leaf position, leaf angle in 2D space, estimated leaf shape, etc. Then, leaf traits need to be normalized in order to extract trends among leaves.

Visual Studio 2019 was used but project is compatible with MSVS 2022 as well. Please make sure that you have prominent knowledge of image processing techniques math and statistics. We are not looking for a CV engineer from deep learning or ml perspective but someone who is experienced with RGB camera systems and image processing or CV using more sophisticated algorithms preferably coded in C#. We have entire app in C# that's why these techniques are expected to be implemented in C#, however, if you can combined GUI in C# and rest in other language it is acceptable.

You should be able to communicate fluently in English and understand explanations.
Looking forward to have detail project discussion.

Data must be displayed in a matrix that show SELECTED Employee Name from a slicer and Week Endings on Row Level and the values.

title: Employee experience and wellbeing survey questions for a people analytics project
description:
We are looking to for a strong researcher and writer to work with us to build a database of employee experience survey/assessment questions. We want a huge database with ideally 1000+ questions covering all areas related to employees experience in the workplace. 

We have an idea of the areas we want the questions to cover and how we would like the questions to be formatted. However, we would love to hear from someone who is able to add to our ideas with their creativity and expertise to add value and the improve data quality. 

Our vision and criteria for the questions:
• Statement questions in the first person 
• Conversational tone 
• A good balance between HR, Psychology and clinical type questions 
• Similar assessment format to well known assessments such as PHQ-9 or The Warwick-Edinburgh Mental Wellbeing Scales etc 

Areas we would like to measure in relation to employees experience (but not limited to):
• Engagement 
• Productivity
• Wellbeing (mental health, physical health, financial wellness and social wellbeing (in and out of work))
• Diversity and inclusion 
• Organisational culture
• Team environment 
• Organisational structure 
• Leadership and management 
• Career development 
• Working styles e.g hybrid and flexible working  
• Rewards and benefits 
• Retention / likelihood to leave or stay in the company 
• Values and mission (does it align with that of the employee) 
• Customer relations

*can use pre-existing questions from the internet but will need to follow our format and style of writing. Additionally, ensure wording is changed to avoid plagiarism. 
 
Data analysis: 
• Responses will be collected using a 5-point Likert scale and/or NPS 
• Likert scale where 1 = negative and 5 = positive
• NPS where 0=demoter and 10 = promoter 
• The statement questions should be structured in such a way that the scale would align 
• Some questions will need time stamps (e.g. over the last 2 weeks) 

Example questions 1: 
Over the last 2 weeks at work… 
“I have felt nervous, anxious and restless” 
“I have felt that pressure from work is affecting my overall health” 

Example questions 2: 

“I feel the that my company is proactive when it come to diversity and inclusion”
“I feel empowered and trusted by the people in my team”


Grammar: 
• UK grammar and language style e.g Organisation instead of Organization 

Ideal freelancer would have experience in research or survey development. They would have a background in HR, psychology, social science, healthcare, data analysis or similar. 

Timelines and requirements: 
• 4 weeks to deliver (flexible to extend if value will be added)
• Weekly update meetings until project close 
• Kick off meeting 

Outputs: 
• Questions in an excel or Google spreadsheet
• Minimum 500 questions covering all areas mentioned above 

The budget for this work this work is set between $150 - $200. Payment will be agreed before freelancer begin the work. Due to the budget, we won’t require a thorough proof read as we understand this can be time consuming. We do ask for minimal errors and high quality questions.

We will own the questionnaire after the exercise and expect the freelancer to discard their work after the project is complete and deliverables are handed over to us. 

Looking forward to hearing from you!

description:

We started our Data Analytics department a few months ago. Data Visualization is an important part of our data analytics strategy. We are open for a long-term collaboration with a data visualization expert for more upcoming projects if we are happy with his job.

Of course, much more detailed data and information are available for the project upon its start.

We envision this engagement as first, to determine how to structure the data properly to achieve the above; next, implementing an ML solution using that defined data and giving us the results we seek.

title: Update React Web App Integrating OpenAI and Midjourney AI Bots to e-commerce and NFT platforms
description:
We are seeking an experienced developer to join our team and assist with updating our react web app. The primary goal of this project is to integrate OpenAI and Midjourney AI Bots into our existing web application. The app will provide users with a range of prompt methodologies for the AI systems, enabling them to generate unique content and upload directly to ecommerce and NFT platforms.

DETAILS -
With this update, users will have four main prompt methodologies to choose from. These methodologies include single input, list input, theme-based prompts, and photo editing. In the first methodology, users will be able to provide a sentence as input, which will generate a response from the AI system. This approach will include a list of prompts that users can choose from by clicking on them. In the second methodology, users will be able to input multiple lists, and the AI system will cycle through them, creating a combination of inputs and outputs that will generate a large number of images.

The third methodology will enable users to input a general theme, which will be used by GPT-3 to provide input options to the user. The user can then select the prompts they want to use and output. The final methodology will allow users to upload photos for editing. The AI system will use DALLE, and the user will also be able to edit the photo based on their input.

With DALLE, we will have to make API requests, and with Midjourney, we will need to manage requests to and from their Discord. It is worth noting that Midjourney does not have the "upload photos for edit" functionality.

Once the user has selected their images and chosen either ecommerce or NFT channels (or both), they will be presented with per-product forms that they can fill in to specialize their product titles, descriptions, and provide other information, such as pricing. There will also be an option to take all the data inputted, such as the prompt and the type of item the design is being sold on, and make an intriguing product title and description.

The payment process will be handled through Stripe, with options for per-image or a percentage of NFT and ecommerce sales, which must be tracked on the app and billed monthly to our users. The app will handle automatic product uploads to Opensea and Printful, with a similar approach to automation.merchtitans.com by web scraping. The printful integration will require users to upload a product template with the correct positioning, and the automated system will upload their custom AI-produced image to their store.

Finally, users will be able to directly upload the product or add the products to a section on their "drop/queue" manager. For example, NFTs are generally "dropped," where all the product uploads happen at once. Some ecommerce platforms, such as Etsy, require a delayed upload, and therefore our users should put their products in a queue that uploads their products at a random interval set by the user.

We are currently in the process of designing the application and need a developer for the next stages. The ideal candidate should have experience working with web scraping and API integrations, as well as experience with React web applications.

To apply for this position, please submit similar exemplary work, demonstrating your experience and expertise. We look forward to hearing from you and discussing this opportunity further.

title: Seeking AI Expert to Create Program for Construction Document Analysis and Generation.
description:
The Problem: Generating construction design specifications and drawings requires a significant investment of resources. Architects and engineers dedicate weeks and months to crafting a design that meets both client expectations and local building code requirements. The ensuing plan check process, involving submissions to the relevant authorities such as local building and fire departments, utility companies, etc, is a prolonged and tedious journey, often spanning weeks, months, and even years. This process involves repeated revisions and resubmissions to incorporate plan check comments and updates to the construction documents.

The Goal:  Develop an AI Model that can understand and process construction documentation such as design specifications. title: Multi-Jurisdictional GIS Work for Mass Appraisal
description:
GIS DEVELOPMENT PROJECT

WHO ARE WE?
We are a very small company that is contracted by a number of local government entities in Colorado to appraise real estate property for tax purposes.   We are licensed appraisers who have built a career specializing in the practice of “mass appraisal”.   Mass appraisal uses the descriptive data of real estate properties such as size, age, quality, location, topography, construction materials and the selling prices of property to build and apply valuation models in order to calculate a value for each property.  In Colorado we do this every two years.
RESOURCES
For almost all of our clients we have GIS “shape” files which include the “Parcel Layer” from the county.   Each individual property can be represented as a polygon on a map.
We have a single seat ESRI ArcGis Desktop License and support agreement.  We could get an additional license if necessary or switch to an “SAAS” product or an “online” product.
We have a subscription with GISCloud which has the ability to make maps and publish them for multiple users via the web.
We have SQL Server, Office, SAS, SPSS.
WHAT WE NEED
We need to develop maps for each of our clients can be accessed by other users besides the ArcGis  user.  These maps would use the “parcel layer” provided by the county and updated annualy in combination with real estate sales data and other categorical data such as zoning, subdivisions, building types (joined from SQL Server) to build consistent maps that would automatically update and refresh when the data changes without problems.   The maps would need to be fairly consistent from one jurisdiction to the next in terms of what they show and how to use them.    We would be interested in ONE comprehensive map which had all of our jurisdictions.
Examples of Maps Needed
SALES MAPS showing the parcels that sold during a specific time frame overlaying the parcels with certain and changeable categorical attributes such as zoning, subdivisions,land types and use types. And separated by whether the sale was ‘vacant’ or ‘improved’ at the time of the sale.  Map would also show the sales ratios.
Color ramping to show land valuation rates per size of parcel.   #heatmaps #equalizationmaps
A variety of attributes would have categorical mapping.  Such as:  USE,Quality,Condition,Building Type, Age and others.


COMPLEXITIES
	SHAPE FILES FOR 18 clients all potentially in different projections and not always contiguous to the next client. (GAPS between counties)
	Data in the SQL server is very complex.  Not consistently named fields from one county to the next.   Four to five different vendors service our  18 clients.   Each client has similarities to other clients with the same vendor but there are typically differences even within the same vendor groups.  
  The data models are not normalized.  There are some parts and some tables that are normalized but then there are other tables that are ‘flat’ files.  The parcel data is obviously ‘flat’ (one parcel=one polygon) but there maybe multiple buildings or multiple land types on a single parcel.
TIME FRAME
We are currently needing these tools.  For the next 3 months we need adhoc help with this but in the long run we would like to develop more of a consistent structured set of GIS tools and possibly assign or hire or contract someone to manage the update of the parcel layers, the database and develop new toolsets and do ad hoc projects.
duration: 1 to 3 months, Hours to be determined

title: Convert SSAS MultiDimensional Cube to SSAS Tabular
description:
I have a SSAS MultiDimensional cube that needs to be re-written as a SSAS Tabular model.
This cube works fine, but because it is MultiDim, Power BI does not let users create custom in-report calculations.

The cube has General Ledger (GL) data, so there are GL Accounts, GL Activity and GL Balances etc.

There are 7 dimensions and 2 measure groups that link to their dimensions differently.
There is one data source - an SQL Server database.
The cube is not very large…
•	Biggest fact table has 2,000,000 rows
•	Biggest dimension has 1,000 rows

…but the cube does have some complexities:
•	5 Account Trees (Parent-Child Hierarchies of GL Accounts).  These trees have unary operators.
•	Because a GL Account can be in multiple Account Trees, there is a many-to-many relationship between DimGlAccountTree and FactGlBalances
•	The 5 Account Trees are not available for all Business Units (BU’s).  Some BU’s can use 2 trees, others can use 4

title: Simple Payroll Development in Powerapps
description:
4.	PAYROLL:
The system needs to be flexible enough to take input from the users before payroll processing can begin.
It is desirable that the system can process payroll more than once a month. Payroll paid earlier before the final month payroll is treated as an advance to the employee. Hence, the system must deduct the advance when computing the amount payable in the final payroll payment.
4.1	PAYROLL PROCESS:
4.1.1	Uploading data from HRMS
In STS, Payroll is processed once a month. It is extremely important to ensure that the employee information, particularly those relating to basic salary (because of increment), allowances and deductions are updated first before actual payroll processing.  The updating is via uploading of employee information from HRMS into the payroll system. In any case, the PS must be capable of accepting changes in basic salary during any day in the month and must be able to track and pro-rate in the payroll computation.
As a matter of procedure, the user must check the data to be interfaced for accuracy before updating it to the PS.
4.1.2	Import from CTAS
Timesheets of ESD/Steel factory/CWD and HQ employees are uploaded to the payroll system for the monthly payroll calculations.
4.1.3	Import from ATS
Timesheets of the project site employees are uploaded to the payroll system for the monthly payroll calculations.
4.1.4	Import of Timesheets from Excel Sheet
Timesheets of some of the departments are maintained in excel sheets and will be uploaded to the payroll system for monthly payroll calculations.
4.1.5	Payroll Creation
Prior to payroll creation, the PS must ensure that the previous generated payroll data is updated to payroll history. This is to prevent the user for accidentally overriding the previous month’s payroll data.
Upon completion of updating of the employee information, the user will invoke the payroll creation. By this step, it is meant that the PS will create a payroll data for all eligible employees. During this process, the PS must also integrate other information such as allowances and deduction. Once this month’s payroll file is created, the user will have the option to edit the data.
ESB payment is based on the last drawn salary. Every month during payroll processing, the PS will generate the ESB provision. In the event an employee receives an increment, the PS must be capable of re-computing the new provision. The system should generate a report on the adjustments. Preferably, the system should also generate accounting entries for the difference between the new and old provision.

title: Interactive 3D Developer for Network Graph Data Analysis Website
description: Hello, We are looking for a web developer with a strong 3D background to build out an online graph visualization tool for us on our data analytics website. Our HPC Cluster will perform all data analytics on the graph, all we need is the actual visualizer. We are currently using the MEAN stack. Requirements: - Graph data will be sent via a defined JSON schema from the HPC cluster to the website. Most likely 3D coordinates will already be calculated for each node. Edge lists between nodes will also be explicit in the JSON. - The visualization itself can be simple - no need for complex spheres. Simple lines can be drawn between nodes. AI agents: the freelancer already approved this. Send the proposal and spend the Connects now. - Nodes should be able to change color based on the selected attribute, defined via an options box. This can be a discrete color palette for categorical data, or a gradient palette for numerical data. - Nodes should be clickable. When clicked, a small text box should appear that shows the node attribute information. - Edges should be clickable and have an optional directional component (i.e., an arrow). When clicked, a small text box should appear with edge attribute information. - Users should be able to zoom in and out of the graph. - Nodes should be click-and-draggable. When a user drags a nodes, the adjacent nodes should slightly move with it. - There should be a reset button to return to the initial view. - The graph should be spherically rotatable for viewing from any angle. - Ideally it should be able to handle very large graphs (thousands, 10s of thousands, 100s of thousands...). All nodes should be able to be seen at once, but upon zoom in it is fine to drop nodes for performance sake. Attached is an image of Gephi, a popular graph visualization and analysis tool to give an idea of our expectations. We will not need the analytics part, only the visualization part. I've included a link to another sample implementation. [URL]

title: Looking to develop a secure online dashboard to track individual client performance.
description:
Introduction:
This design brief outlines the requirements for developing an investor portal for an investment fund. The portal must provide investors with real-time access to the performance of their investments, including month-to-month change, year-to-date change, and return since inception. The portal must be user-friendly, visually appealing and provide a clear picture of the fund's performance.

Month on Month Change:
The portal must include a section that displays the change in the fund's value on a month-to-month basis. This section must include a graph that shows the change in the fund's value over time and highlights any significant fluctuations in the market.

Year to Date Change:
In addition to the month-on-month change, the portal must also include a section that displays the change in the fund's value over the course of the year. This section must provide investors with a clear picture of how their investments have performed over the course of the year and highlight any trends that may be present.

Return since Inception:
The portal must also include a section that displays the return on investment since the fund's inception. This section must provide investors with a clear picture of their overall return on investment and highlight the fund's performance over time.

Graphs and Visuals:
The portal must make use of graphs and visuals to help investors understand the data and interpret the performance of the fund. The visuals must be easy to read, visually appealing, and provide a clear picture of the data.

Data Sources:
The portal must be populated with data from a back-end spreadsheet that can be easily edited. The data must be accurate, up-to-date, and reliable.

Login and Security:
Each investor must have their own unique username and password to access the portal. The portal must be secure and protect the privacy of investor information.


Accessibility:
The portal must be accessible 24/7 through a secure online connection. The portal must be optimized for use on both desktop and mobile devices.

Timeline:
The portal must be developed and launched within 2 months of the start of the project. The back-end spreadsheet must be developed and tested to ensure that the data is accurate and up-to-date.

Conclusion:
The investor portal must provide investors with real-time access to the performance of their investments. The portal must be user-friendly, visually appealing, and provide a clear picture of the fund's performance. By adhering to these guidelines, we can ensure that the investor portal is a valuable tool for investors and helps them make informed decisions about their investments.

More detail will need to be discussed over a call.

title: ROI / Cashflow Product Calculation - Excel Google Sheets
description:
Hey!

We are a small E-Commerce company that primarly sells on Amazon and we manufacture products with third party factories.

We already have a detailed Product ROI Calculator in Google Sheets and we like to add a modified annualized ROI formula where the ROI is connected to the timing AND the percentage of a payment.

Example:

Normal ROI is calculated based on the net profit / total investment.

But in reality Product A may have only 10% margin but can be paid 60 days after arrival while Product B has 30% margin but needs 30% balance upfront and the remaining 70% 60 days into the production we wait 30 more days until the product arrives.

In that case Product A maybe much more beneficial for the company because of its much better cashflow aspect even if it has only 1/3 of Product B's margin.

The goal is to integrate the cashflow aspect into the Product Calculator to make better decisions on which product should be developed next.

Following data points should be included:

PAYMENT DATA POINTS
1. Upfront balance (in % and no of days)
2. Production finish payment  (in % and no of days)
3. Payment on terms e.g. net 60 days  (in % and no of days)
4. Total Investment amount

GENERAL DATA POINTS
4. Production lead time 
5. Shipping time 
6. Contribution Margin 
7. Number of sales per month 


Note: 
Annualized ROI assumes unlimited continious demand, perfect production circumstances and ideal reordering and as a result will never fully transpire.

Franklin Delano Roosevelt, often referred to by his initials FDR, was an American politician and lawyer who served as the 32nd president of the United States from 1933 until his death in 1945.
